selection.rule: CR candidates = feasible rows (tpl_record feasible, no error) of the CR_N-point scrambled Sobol sample of the corner sub-box (seed CR_SOBOL_SEED), whose Euclidean distance in the phase-13 unit cube (13 columns = Phase(13).vars, all designs unclipped) to every evaluated design (each 3406 design job in the queue, any stage / state, plus the SF-1 designs of this batch) is >= CR_EXCL_R. CR-1 = greedy maximin among them, groups e* == 0 / e* != 0 alternating 0, 1, 0, 1, ... (16 + 16); each step takes the candidate of the group with the largest distance to the points already chosen (ties: lowest Sobol index); the first point is the lowest-index candidate of group 0. CR-1 spacing = min pairwise distance in CR-1. CR-T = the same greedy maximin (15 + 15, alternating) continued on the remaining feasible rows with CR-1 and every evaluated design pre-placed: each CR-T point is the candidate farthest from CR-1, the evaluated designs and the CR-T points already chosen; hard floor CR_EXCL_R to CR-1 and to the evaluated designs. The literal requirement 'distance >= the CR-1 spacing to CR-1 and to every evaluated design' is checked and reported (crt_literal_candidates); in 13 dimensions it is a packing limit and can have no candidate at all.
selection.metric: Euclidean distance in the phase-13 unit cube (columns = Phase(13).vars)

total.model: slot-min per new job SF 30.75 / CR 23.25 + 0.6 if bonded; wall = slot-h / (3 slots x 85%); 'bond_in_rate' = the plan's per-job figure already averaging the 20 % bonded share
